newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Morgan Guaranty issues 10 bln esc bonds.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Guaranty issues 10 bln esc bonds.

text.p: Morgan Guaranty Trust is issuing 10 billion escudos of 10-year, zero coupon bonds with repayment guaranteed at 197.08 percent, lead manager Banco Portugues de Investimento and Caixa Geral de Depositos said.

The guarantee implies an annual yield of 7.02 percent. The issuer can opt to turn the bond into a variable-rate issue after one year at six-month Lisbor plus 20 basis points, the banks added in a statement.
